description: Hey, we are the durango team, we're planning to make a game, for now we are two programmer's looking for others programmer's and people with making games experience
summary:
We developed Xeno 11, a 2D run-by-Godot videogame that puts the player into a strategic simulation of a space mission. Since the construction of the rocket until the launching, Xeno 11 includes several mini games that make the experience much more enjoyable.
With this project, we are looking for a creative and attractive approach of the stablished challenge, where players can have a good time while understanding a little how a space mission works.
